rows.label: Mother Token
rows.note: from Cambion Drift bounties, plus occasional tokens found in the Drift

conditions: Tokens are not event-limited: bank them year-round and spend when Daughter opens her shop.
bonuses: Fish for the Brute Force bounty: start a bounty at your tier, fly toward the first stage then away to fail it in ~15 seconds, then a Mother NPC in the Drift offers a fresh set of three; different Mothers offer different sets, and Brute Force is the consistently fastest.
The endless (excavation-style) Mother bounty pays about 250-275 tokens over four rotations, enough for two Ceti Lacera in one session.

disclosures.title: other event vendors, if one reruns
disclosures.body: Ceti Lacera has also been sold by returning-rewards shops during Operation reruns: Ordis for 15 Volatile Motes (Belly of the Beast), Dominus Thrax for 9 Dominus Aureus (Eight Claw), Roathe for 20 Marks of Valiance (Blood of Perita), 3 Grotesque Splinters (Gargoyle's Cry), 2,000 Phasic Cells (Orphix Venom) or 20,000 Scarlet Credits (the original Scarlet Spear). Each is limit 1 and only helps if that Operation happens to be rerunning.

conditions: Only on sale during Nights of Naberus, which has appeared every year since 2021, normally early October into early November.
MR 12 gate to buy from Daughter; the blueprint is tradeable, so buy it from another player instead if you're under it.
bonuses: Buy on day one of the event using tokens banked in advance.
